synthesis.summary: The n=6 full-support certification chain is sound as it stands: across four audits, the completeness critic, and my own spot checks of the working tree at HEAD 074ed87, no false verdict and no unsound step was found. Every polynomial region2d uses is the one the lemmas name (Delta_{m-1} of the monic det(mu I + K), D = p(0), a_i = adj(C)1, no o_k for full support); the positivity restriction is Lemma A.2; the pointwise decision is three-valued exact Hurwitz with resampling and 0 escalations; the projection set is the correct Collins/McCallum set and delineability held empirically on every graph tested; the Descartes replay is correct under fuzzing and catches tampering; coverage is exact (every index 0..1540943 once in the limit shards, 34,071 survivor records with 0 duplicates/errors, four stable = K6 + idx 1000255, 1424629, 1387528, each stable record with 0 undecided cells); the 298 resumed v1-era records were re-certified with 0 verdict changes (5250bd5); and the two-parameter Lemma B', openness (Lemma O') and delineability are now proved in notes/lemma_Bprime_2d.md (074ed87), closing the proof-coverage gaps. The three counterexamples reproduce under four independent methods, and the stable region of idx 1387528 was re-derived from scratch in sympy as exactly {2 < beta < beta_1', t > 1/(beta-2)}, beta_1' the unique real root of beta^5-3beta^4+3beta^3-3beta^2+2beta-1 in (152/73, 25/12). No gap would change a verdict, so nothing is blocking in the task's sense. What keeps this from being a finished certified theorem are four major items: (1) the human hand-verification of idx 1387528 and 1424629 that CLAUDE.md section 3 requires before anything is built on them is still outstanding (a process gate, not a mathematical gap, but the project's own definition of done); (2) the never side -- 34,067 CAD verdicts and 1.5M filter verdicts -- has no self-contained certificate and no independent checker run over the full set, so it rests on re-running the same sympy-based engine plus sample-based evidence, part of which (auditor 3's 40-graph adversarial spot-check, the dense search on 24 remaining never-graphs, the spectral scan beyond 9,834 survivors) never finished; (3) the written theorem is false or imprecise in several places I verified exactly (the 'cannot have a positive fixed point' claim fails for the empty graph, the Lemma H misquote, the empty interval (152/73, 27/13) which should be (152/73, 25/12), '~1.0789' which should be ~1.0830, unpinned definitions of stable/legal/nondegenerate, a stale status line); (4) all 17 HITS certificate files, including the full 2-D certificates of the three counterexamples, are still untracked because .gitignore lines 4-5 match them, and the bulk records have no manifest. The minor items are provenance hygiene (mixed-filter limit shards overwriting the clean replay in aggregate.py; n<=5 artifacts from superseded code, re-run with 0 differences but not committed), certificate presentation (margin roots in beta_critical, isolating-interval ends standing in for algebraic cell endpoints), trust-base hardening h1-h4 and environment pinning, a sign typo in the Lemma A(i) proof text, an unwritten Lemma N extension for the limit engine, a Lemma C wording point, and the optional Lean formalization. Recommended order: obtain the human sign-off; fix the report statements and track the HITS files (minutes); then build and validate the independent never-checker and run it over everything.

Method. With eps=1/(t+1), delta=(beta-1)eps: (t+1)(I-W) = N = K + tJ, K = -(beta-1)I + beta(J - A^T). Because J is rank one, adj(N)·1 = adj(K)·1 is t-free and det N = D0(beta) + t·s(beta) with s = sum a_i; so x_i = (t+1)a_i(beta)/D(beta,t). a_0 = beta^4-3beta^3+4beta^2-2beta+1, a_1 = -(beta^3-3beta^2+2beta-1), a_2 = (beta-1)^2(beta^2-beta+1), a_3 = (beta-1)(beta^3-2beta^2+beta-1), a_4 = beta^2-beta+1, a_5 = -(beta^5-3beta^4+3beta^3-3beta^2+2beta-1). Positivity therefore reduces to beta in (2, beta_1') plus D>0, and D>0 holds on the whole legal half-line since (beta-2)D0+s = E(beta) > 0 there. Stability of -I+W is equivalent to Hurwitz stability of det(uI+N) (u=(t+1)s). I computed Delta_1..Delta_6 (Delta_6 = D·Delta_5), then a McCallum/Collins-style projection in beta (leading coefficients, discriminants, resultant with the legal boundary (beta-2)t-1, content) and counted real roots with my own Sturm-sequence counter (cross-checked against sympy's isolator). No repository file was modified (git status clean; region2d.py sha256 equals HEAD).

Verdict: I found no step in the certification chain that is false, and no place where the code assumes something the mathematics does not deliver. Every polynomial region2d uses is exactly what Lemma B names (Delta_{m-1} of the monic det(mu I + K), its constant term D, a_i = adj(C)1, and no o_k for the full support), the positivity restriction is Lemma A.2, the pointwise decision is Corollary A.1 with the three-valued Hurwitz test, and legality is enforced through the curve L. What is missing is on the proof side: (1) Lemma B is only proved at fixed t while region2d needs the two-parameter version (constancy of the verdict on connected components of the complement of {a_i D Delta_{m-1} = 0}), and (2) the CAD delineability theorem that turns 'no projection root in the beta-cell' into 'the sample verdict is the cell verdict' is neither proved nor cited. Both are standard and the proofs extend verbatim, but as written the notes do not cover the step that decides 34,067 graphs. Minor items: a sign typo in the Lemma A(i) proof text; never-records are not self-contained witnesses; the stored k<=5 certificates come from the superseded v1 engine (the v2 re-run agreed but its records were not kept); the replay trusts sympy's factor attribution. Empirical adversarial checks (exact arithmetic throughout): (b3) on 200 constructed polynomials; curves vs direct symbolic construction on 7 graphs; A.1/A.2 on 1500 random proper supports; Lemma R/padding on 400 cases; delineability and cell verdicts on the 4 stable certificates (216 points) and 25 random never-survivors (~700 points, plus 960 random legal points in their positivity cells: 0 stable); 3200 random legal points on 80 non-survivors: 0 positive fixed points; all 237 digraphs with n<=4 re-certified by the committed engine; test_ctln.py 20/20.
